notes:
Summary:
- Platform: Cascade RelayWorks (omnichannel contact center vendor focused on automated deflection + routed agent assist)
- Primary ask: cost-sensitive high-volume chat deflection. Want to push 40-60% deflection for tier-1 traffic while preserving NPS.
- Workloads: ~120k chatbot interactions/day (baseline), peaks up to 18k concurrent interactions during campaigns; typical message length short (40-80 tokens) but some troubleshooting threads 2-3 turns longer.
- Performance targets: P95 end-to-end assistant response <200ms, P99 <350ms for deflection flows; agent-assist tool-calls allowed up to 500ms.
- Cost goals: reduce per-interaction inference cost by >=50% vs current vendor; finance target $250k-750k ARR with unit economics: target <$0.015 per handled chat after deflection.
- Model preference: open-weight models for cost control (quantized 13B as primary), fall back to larger model for low-confidence escalations.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic model fallback when dedicated capacity saturated; prefer routing by latency SLO first, then cost.
- Caching/Batching: heavy interest in prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts; plan to batch short-turn queries aggressively during peaks.
- Quantization: must support INT8/4 quantized variants and recommended kernel sets; want concrete delta on latency/cost vs FP16.
- Reliability: need graceful degradation under spikes (canary to smaller models, queued batching, or best-effort synthetics).
- Compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs, 90-day retention default, EU data residency for EU enterprise customers.

Timeline / Activities:
- 2026-02-22 — Intro call w/ AE (Jordan) + product. Notes: "we're burning cash on API bills during promos"; asked for sample cost model.
- 2026-02-26 — NDA and data access form sent.
- 2026-03-01 — Technical deep dive (Maya Chen + infra). Reviewed current architecture: multi-tenant public cloud + self-hosted edge workers for gateway. Discussed batching strategies and KV cache design.
- 2026-03-04 — POC kickoff: 2-week technical POC scheduled (shadowing live traffic, 10% routing). Drive doc: /drive/pricing/decks/cascade-relayworks-pricing-v2.pdf attached.
- 2026-03-05 — Security questionnaire submitted (SEC-2310). Security team flagged SOC2 gap and asked for KMS/HSM details.
- 2026-03-08 — POC mid-run sync. Early latency numbers look good for quantized 13B (avg token latency down 40%). Concern: P99 tail still spikes when concurrent KV cache misses > 10%.
- 2026-03-09 — Finance call to discuss ARR/discount thresholds.

Technical notes (shorthand):
- Traffic pattern: many shallow queries => excellent candidate for caching of common prefixes.
- Prefer continuous batching over fixed batching to keep latency tight.
- Want auto-scaling + burst buffer for marketing spikes (holiday sale scenario).
- Will require model version pinning per customer segment (enterprise clients on larger/low-latency stack).
- Tool-calling: need to support structured tool responses (ticket creation, internal KB lookup) + idempotency for retried calls.
